sentences.text: Aarhus -LRB- -LSB- ˈɒːhuːˀs -RSB- ; officially spelled Århus from 1948 until 31 December 2010 -RRB- is the second-largest city in Denmark and the seat of Aarhus municipality .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Denmark	Denmark	Aarhus municipality	Aarhus municipality

It is located on the east coast of the Jutland peninsula , in the geographical centre of Denmark , 187 km northwest of Copenhagen and 289 km north of Hamburg , Germany .	Denmark	Denmark	Jutland	Jutland	Copenhagen	Copenhagen	Hamburg	Hamburg	Germany	Germany
The inner urban area contains 269,022 inhabitants and the municipal population is 335,684 .	urban area	urban area

Aarhus is the central city in the East Jutland metropolitan area , which had a total population of 1.378 million in 2016 .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Jutland	Jutland	East Jutland metropolitan area	East Jutland metropolitan area

The history of Aarhus began as a fortified Viking settlement founded in the 8th century and with the first written records stemming from the bishopric seated here from at least 948 .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Viking	Viking	bishopric	bishopric

The city was founded on the northern shores of a fjord at a natural harbour and the primary driver of growth was for centuries seaborne trade in agricultural products .	a fjord	Förden and East Jutland Fjorde	natural harbour	natural harbour

Market town privileges were granted in 1441 , but growth stagnated in the 17th century as the city suffered blockades and bombardments during the Swedish Wars .	Market town	Market town	Swedish Wars	Dano-Swedish War (1658–60)
In the 19th century it was occupied twice by German troops during the Schleswig Wars but avoided destruction .	Schleswig Wars	First Schleswig War
As the industrial revolution took hold , the city grew to become the second-largest in the country by the 20th century .	industrial revolution	industrial revolution
Today Aarhus is at the cultural and economic core of the region and the largest centre for trade , services and industry in Jutland .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Jutland	Jutland

The city ranks as the 92nd largest city in the European Union , and as number 234 among world cities .	European Union	European Union	number 234	List of largest cities of the European Union by population within city limits	world cities	world cities
It is also a top 100 conference city in the world .	conference	Meeting
Aarhus is the principal industrial port of the country in terms of container handling and an important trade hub in Kattegat .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	port	port	Kattegat	Kattegat

Major Danish companies have based their headquarters here and people commute for work and leisure from a wide area in Region Midtjylland .	Region	Regions of Denmark	Region Midtjylland	Region Midtjylland

It is a centre for research and education in the Nordic countries and home to Aarhus University , Scandinavia 's largest university , including Aarhus University Hospital and INCUBA Science Park .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Nordic countries	Nordic countries	Aarhus University	Aarhus University	Scandinavia	Scandinavia	Aarhus University Hospital	Aarhus University Hospital	INCUBA Science Park	INCUBA Science Park

Being the Danish city with the youngest demographics , with 48,482 inhabitants aged under 18 , Aarhus is also the second fastest growing Danish city , with an average growth of 4,500 people per annum since 2008 .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality
Aarhus is notable for its musical history .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality
In the 1950s many jazz clubs sprang up around the city , fuelled by the young population .	jazz	jazz
By the 1960s , the music scene diversified into rock and other genres .	rock	rock music

In the 1970s and 1980s , Aarhus became the centre for Denmark 's rock music fostering many iconic bands such as TV-2 and Gnags .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Denmark	Denmark	rock	rock music	TV-2	TV-2 (band)	Gnags	Gnags

Aarhus is home to the annual eight-day Aarhus International Jazz Festival , the SPoT Festival and the NorthSide Festival .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	Aarhus International Jazz Festival	Aarhus International Jazz Festival	SPoT Festival	Spot (music festival)	NorthSide Festival	NorthSide Festival (Denmark)
In 2017 , Aarhus has been selected as European Capital of Culture along with Paphos in Cyprus .	Aarhus	Aarhus Municipality	European Capital of Culture	European Capital of Culture	Paphos	Paphos
